gpu_bytes: Decoded mesh accessors (what the loader uploads) plus RGBA8 textures with mipmaps, width * height * 4 * 4/3. WebP and JPEG do not stay compressed on the GPU. KTX2 would; this project does not ship a Basis transcoder.

models/korean_castle.glb.note: Already meshopt. Re-quantizing the geometry made the file larger, so only the JPEGs moved to WebP. The encrusted-steel maps are 1024 and dominate the GPU estimate.

models/observation_rov.glb.note: Rotor positions are tested at 1e-5, so the meshopt geometry was not quantized again. Textures are WebP. Six 2K maps decode to RGBA8.

models/observation_rov_lod1.glb.note: Same texture set as the near model, already downscaled, now WebP.

models/rov.glb.note: Training X1 LOD0 is already meshopt and the legacy centre plus rotor tests depend on it. It was not recompressed.

models/workboat.glb.note: Authored LOD0/1/2 are already in the file. Quality mode scales those distances.

models/workboat_high.glb.note: 2048 hull maps, loaded only at high and ultra.

retained_unloaded.models/aquaculture/pen.glb: Portable preview of the pen. The runtime draws the net from net.webp. docs/design/scene-looks/README.md
retained_unloaded.models/aquaculture/mission.json: Sample mission committed for portable viewing, not fetched by the viewer. docs/design/scenes/aquaculture/README.md
